locale.name: settings.throttleIpLimit.description
locale.en: How many registration attempts are allowed from the same IP address within 15 minutes. Failed attempts count too. Several people may share an IP address, for example on a company network. The window starts with the first attempt and is not extended by further attempts. Default: 20. Whole numbers from 1 to 1000000 are accepted; invalid values use the default.

locale.name: settings.throttleIdentityLimit.description
locale.en: How many registration attempts are allowed for the same email address or username within 15 minutes, including attempts from different IP addresses. Email addresses and usernames are counted separately. Failed attempts count too. Letter case and leading or trailing whitespace are ignored when counting. The window starts with the first attempt and is not extended by further attempts. Default: 5. Whole numbers from 1 to 1000000 are accepted; invalid values use the default.

locale.name: admin.types.registrationSignUp.setting.logo.description
locale.en: Specify which logo should be used at the sign up. This can be set separately to the project logo. If the setting is empty, the project logo will be used.

locale.name: admin.types.registrationSignUp.setting.fullscreen.description
locale.en: The registration should be displayed in the entire viewport and cover all other elements of the page. A login button will be shown at the top right.

locale.name: mail.text.registrationWelcome.description
locale.en: Frontend Users: Registration - E-mail which the user receives when he/she has successfully registered.

locale.name: order.registrationWelcome.subject.description
locale.en:
Subject of the welcome e-mail. Available variables:

  • [host]: Host of the project (system)

locale.name: order.registrationWelcome.body.description
locale.en:
Content of the welcome e-mail. Available variables:

  • [host]: Host of the project (system)
  • [loginUrl]: URL (link) for the login
  • [userPassword]: Text section containing the login credentials, including the password generated for the user
  • [username]: Username
  • [userFirstName]: First name of the user (if available)
  • [userLastName]: Last name of the user (if available)

locale.name: mail.text.activation.description
locale.en: Frontend Users: Registration - E-mail which the user receives for his activation.

locale.name: order.activation.subject.description
locale.en:
Subject of the activation e-mail. Available variables:

  • [host]: Host of the project (system)

locale.name: order.activation.body.description
locale.en:
Content of the activation e-mail. Available variables:

  • [host]: Host of the project (system)
  • [userId]: User id of the user
  • [date]: Date of the registration
  • [email]: E mail of the user
  • [activationLink]: Activation link
  • [username]: Username
  • [userFirstName]: First name of the user (if available)
  • [userLastName]: Last name of the user (if available)

locale.name: mail.text.confirmEmail.title
locale.en: Frontend Users: Confirmation of e-mail address

locale.name: mail.text.confirmEmail.description
locale.en: Email for confirmation of an email address.

locale.name: order.confirmEmail.subject.description
locale.en:
Subject of the confirmation e-mail. Available variables:

  • [host]: Host of the project (system)

locale.name: order.confirmEmail.body.description
locale.en:
Content of the confirmation e-mail. Available variables:

  • [host]: Host of the project (system)
  • [userId]: User id of the user
  • [email]: E mail of the user
  • [confirmLink]: Confirmation link (must be included!)
  • [username]: Username
  • [userFirstName]: First name of the user (if available)
  • [userLastName]: Last name of the user (if available)

locale.name: mail.text.changeEmail.description
locale.en: Frontend Users: E-mail the user receives when he wants to change his e-mail address.

locale.name: order.changeEmail.subject.description
locale.en:
Subject of the e-mail address changes. Available variables:

  • has no variables

locale.name: order.changeEmail.body.description
locale.en:
Content of the e-mail address changes. Available variables:

  • [host]: Host of the project (system)
  • [userId]: User id of the user
  • [newEmail]: New E mail of the user
  • [date]: Date of the change request
  • [confirmLink]: Link for the confirmation
  • [username]: Username
  • [userFirstName]: First name of the user (if available)
  • [userLastName]: Last name of the user (if available)

locale.name: mail.text.deleteUserConfirmation.description
locale.en: Frontend Users: E-mail which the user receives when he wants to delete his account

locale.name: order.deleteUserConfirmation.subject.description
locale.en:
Subject of the user delete e-mail. Available variables:

  • has no variables

locale.name: order.deleteUserConfirmation.body.description
locale.en:
Content of the user deletion e-mail. Available variables:

  • [host]: Host of the project (system)
  • [userId]: User id of the user
  • [date]: Date of the deletion request
  • [confirmLink]: Link for the confirmation
  • [username]: Username
  • [userFirstName]: First name of the user (if available)
  • [userLastName]: Last name of the user (if available)
